newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker steady despite cargo strength.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker steady despite cargo strength.

text.p: The Singapore bunker quotes held steady on Thursday but enquiries were few and many shipowners stayed on the sidelines, traders said.

The 180-cst grade was quoted by majors at around $101 per tonne and the 180-cst was at about $108. MDO and gas oil stabilised at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively. Traders said the recent firm cargo market failed to boost bunker levels because of poor bunker demand.
"Many shipowners have turned to other ports. You can raise offers as high as you want but no-one will be interested," said one supplier. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
